slides.h1: Your Routine Keeps Failing Because It Was Built for Someone Else's Chart
slides.sub: The 6th house and dinacharya (the Ayurvedic daily routine) tell you where your habits will fight you.

slides.h2: The 6th house: daily work and upkeep
slides.body: The 6th house (Shashtha bhava) governs routine, digestion, service and the small habits that repeat every day. It shows how your system handles load.
Dinacharya is the classical idea of a fixed daily rhythm: waking, eating and resting in step with natural cycles. Jyotish asks which version of it suits you.

points: Moon-heavy 6th: needs flexible meal and sleep windows
Saturn on the 6th: thrives on strict, slow, repeated structure
Mars on the 6th: needs a physical outlet before desk work
Read the 6th lord and its dasha (planetary period) too

slides.body: Astrology is not diagnosis or treatment. For any health concern, see a qualified doctor. This is a habit-design lens, nothing more.
Pick one habit and change one variable for two weeks: its timing. Track energy, not willpower. Keep what the data supports.
